The Membes in their Annual General Meeting held on wednesday, the 31st July, 2024 by passsing Special Resolution, accorded to Mrs. Gita Bawa (DIN : 00111003), Director of the Company, to continue to hold the office as Non-Executive Independent Director of the Company till her re-appointment which ends on 29th May, 2026 notwithstanding that Mrs. Gita Bawa will attain the age of 75 years on 19th day of June, 2025.
Further, Mrs. Gita Bawa has ceased to be a Member of the Audit Committee, Nomination and Remuneration Committee and Stakeholders Relationship Committee with effect from 13th February, 2026, follwing the conclusion of the meeting held on that date.
3. Mr. Sudhir Avasthi (DIN: 00152375) appointed as Managing Directors of the Company w.e.f 01st July, 2021 by the Members by passing Special Resolution in their 48th Annual Geneal Meeting held on Tuesday, the 28th September, 2021 .
Further, the Member in their 52nd Annual General Meeting of the members of the Company held on Thursday, the 25th September, 2025, approved by passing Special Resolution the re-appointment of Mr. Sudhir Avasthi (DIN: 00152375), as Managing Director of the Company, for a period of 5 (Five) years, on expiry of his present term of office, i.e. with effect from 01st July, 2026 to 30th June, 2031, notwithstanding that Mr. Sudhir Avasthi will attain the age of Seventy years on 23rd day of April, 2026.
4. The Members in their Annual General Meeting held on Wednesday, the 31st July, 2024 by passsing Special Resolution, re-appointed Mr. Anil Girota (DIN: 00110631) as an Independent Director of the Company, not liable to retire by rotation, for a second term of five consecutive years commencing from 13th February, 2025 to 12th February, 2030 (both days inclusive).
5. Mrs. Namita Swain (DIN: 10211413), Independent Director has been appointed as Member of the Audit Committee, Nominatin and Remuneration Committee and Stakeholders Relationship Committee with effect from 13th February, 2026.
